verdict.rationale: AMD's product spec page documents NVMe support (boot, RAID0, RAID1) and a maximum of four displays, which helps with storage and multi-monitor dock planning. Nothing in the pack covers PCIe generation or lane counts, or external I/O such as USB4 or Thunderbolt. missing for 10: PCIe generation and lane count specs, USB4/Thunderbolt/external connectivity specs, storage interface speed details, independent corroboration of I/O headroom.

support.subject: As a developer, the platform has documented I/O headroom — PCIe generation and lanes, fast storage, and external connectivity specs I can plan a build or dock setup around
